summary.text: David J. Else won the Legal Marijuana Now Party primary and is on the Nov. 3, 2026 general-election ballot for Nebraska's 3rd District.

paragraphs.text: Lives in Overton, Nebraska, according to the Nebraska Examiner.
BallotReady lists his professional experience as farmer.
Was the Democratic nominee for this seat in 2022, losing to Rep. Adrian Smith, who received 78.3% of the vote.
Won the Legal Marijuana NOW Party primary in May 2026 and is that party's nominee.
